$comment: boxPx, baselinePx, deltaE2000, ssimNonText and ssimElement are calibrated in M0 (docs/findings/m0.md §11). The text ink keys are calibrated by the fidelity suite against macOS Chromium goldens (docs/findings/text-ink.md): the golden's font smoothing makes the design's stems heavier than Unity's SDF text, more for light text and at small sizes. textInkRatio: Unity's ink amount relative to the design's for correct text (measured 0.69-1.03); a line passes between textInkRatio x (1 - textInkCoverage) and 1 + textInkCoverage, and within textInkMedianTolerance of the capture's median ratio of text of the same polarity (light on dark, dark on light) when there are 3 or more such lines. Ink colour: textInkDeltaE from textInkFullPx device px (font size; measured 0 there), below that the first [px, limit] pair of textInkDeltaESmall whose size the text reaches (measured maxima 3.90 at 12 px, 7.96 at 9 px, 11.32 at 8 px, 9.46 at 6 px)
